package.title: 99 English Grammar MCQs for PPSC and PMS-Style Practice

questions.question: Neither the clerk nor the assistants ___ available to answer the query.
Every one of the application forms ___ a signature.
A number of applicants ___ asked for additional time.
The number of vacant positions ___ lower than expected.
The news about the selection ___ encouraging.
Economics ___ one of the subjects in her course.
Each boy and girl ___ given a separate entry card.
The committee ___ its final recommendation as a single group.
The police ___ the damaged equipment at the site.
Neither the teacher nor the students ___ ready to leave.
She ___ in Lahore since 2021.
By the time we reached the station, the train ___.
If you heat ice, it ___.
If I ___ the principal, I would extend the library hours.
If she had left earlier, she ___ the bus.
When the meeting ___, I will send you the notes.
The technician ___ the printer at the moment.
We ___ the notice on Monday.
My uncle ___ in Multan, but he moved to Quetta last year.
At 8 a.m., Sana ___ for the bus for thirty minutes.
He is ___ honest officer.
She hopes to study at ___ university near her home.
The Earth moves around ___ Sun.
They hope to climb ___ Mount Everest one day.
Imran has ___ MBA and works in administration.
In the sentence “___ rich should help those in need,” which article completes the sentence?
We waited for ___ hour before the doors opened.
She bought ___ European history book at the sale.
___ Indus is a major river in Pakistan.
He gave the document to Ali and ___.
The person ___ chaired the meeting thanked the staff.
The colleague to ___ I sent the file replied quickly.
One should keep ___ promises.
This is the writer ___ novel won the prize.
The two researchers prepared the presentation ___.
The company changed ___ name last year.
The applicant ___ the panel selected accepted the offer.
The director, along with two assistants, ___ attending the briefing.
She is interested ___ environmental research.
Hamza is good ___ solving word problems.
The success of the plan depends ___ careful preparation.
All staff members must comply ___ the safety instructions.
The witness accused the driver ___ careless driving.
I prefer tea ___ coffee in the morning.
The bus arrived ___ the station just before noon.
The teacher divided the class ___ four groups.
They have lived in this neighbourhood ___ five years.
___ the heavy rain, the match continued.
The supervisor is responsible ___ checking the final figures.
The committee insisted ___ reviewing the figures once more.
The coach congratulated the team ___ its victory.
This edition is different ___ the earlier one.
This container is capable ___ holding ten litres.
The speaker explained the procedure ___.
After completing the difficult puzzle, she worked ___ on the next one.
There are ___ applicants this year than last year.
We need ___ information before making a decision.
This route is shorter ___ the one we took yesterday.
Of the three candidates, Nadia is the ___ speaker.
This exercise is not as difficult ___ the previous one.
The road was ___ narrow that the bus could not pass.
The tea was too hot ___ immediately.
The room is large enough ___ a group of twenty.
Which sentence correctly says that the room was completely quiet?
___ the report, Sara emailed it to her manager.
Which sentence has a modifier that clearly refers to Ali?
choices: Walking to the bus stop, Ali found a wallet.
Walking to the bus stop, a wallet was found by Ali.
A wallet walking to the bus stop was found by Ali.
Ali found walking to the bus stop a wallet.

questions.question: Choose the sentence in which “broken” describes the window.
choices: The broken window was repaired yesterday.
Yesterday the broken was window repaired.

questions.question: ___ the manager and the accountant attended the briefing.
The office is open ___ on Fridays ___ on public holidays.
___ tired, Ayesha completed the assignment before dinner.
___ you save the file, you may lose your changes.
No sooner had the train stopped ___ the passengers began to leave.
Scarcely had the lecture begun ___ the power went out.
You may choose ___ the blue folder ___ the green one.
___ the players ___ the coach knew the revised schedule.
The report ___ by the finance officer yesterday.
The road ___ by workers at this moment.
People speak Urdu in many parts of Pakistan. Which is the correct passive form?
choices: Urdu speaks in many parts of Pakistan.
Urdu is spoken in many parts of Pakistan.
Urdu has spoke in many parts of Pakistan.
Urdu was speaking in many parts of Pakistan.

questions.question: Which is the correct passive form of “Who wrote this letter?”
choices: By whom was this letter written?
By whom this letter was writing?

questions.question: Choose the correct reported form: He said, “I am tired.”
choices: He said that I am tired.
He said that he was tired.
He says that he had tired.

questions.question: Choose the correct reported form: She said, “I have completed the task.”
choices: She said that she completed the task tomorrow.
She said that I had completed the task.
She said that she had completed the task.
She said that she has complete the task.

questions.question: A teacher addressed Ali and asked, “Will you help me?” Which report correctly preserves that context?
choices: The teacher asked Ali whether he would help her.
The teacher said Ali that will he help me.
The teacher asked Ali whether I would help him.
The teacher asked that Ali will help her.

questions.question: The teacher said to Ali, “Close the window.” Choose the correct reported form.
choices: The teacher told Ali close the window.
The teacher told Ali to close the window.
The teacher said Ali that close the window.
The teacher asked that Ali closed the window.

questions.question: The guard said to us, “Do not touch the equipment.” Choose the correct report.
choices: The guard told us not to touch the equipment.
The guard told us do not touched the equipment.
The guard said us not touching the equipment.
The guard asked us to not touched the equipment.

questions.question: Choose the sentence with a parallel list.
choices: The course teaches reading, writing, and how to calculate.
The course teaches reading, writing, and calculating.
The course teaches to read, writing, and calculation.
The course teaches reading, to write, and calculating.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the standard comparison for two employees?
choices: Zara is more senior from Hina.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the standard construction for preference?
choices: He prefers walking over than driving.
He prefers to walking than driving.

questions.question: Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
choices: She is one of the employees who works on weekends.
She is one of the employees who work on weekends.
She is one of the employee who work on weekends.
She is one of employees who works on weekends.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: She is the only one of the employees who work on weekends.
She is the only one of the employees who works on weekends.
She is the only one of employees who works on weekends.
She is the only one of the employee who work on weekends.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly shows that the device belongs to the company?
Which sentence correctly joins two complete, closely related statements?
choices: The rain stopped, we resumed the match.
The rain stopped; we resumed the match.
The rain stopped because; we resumed the match.
The rain stopped we; resumed the match.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly addresses Ahmed by name?
choices: Please submit the form Ahmed before noon.
Please Ahmed, submit the form before noon.
Please, Ahmed, submit the form before noon.
Please Ahmed submit, the form before noon.

questions.question: Choose the sentence with correct subject–verb agreement.
choices: The list of supplies are on the desk.
The list of supplies is on the desk.
The list of supplies were on the desk.
The list of supplies have been on the desk.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses an apostrophe to show that the files belong to several teachers?
Choose the sentence with the correct verb form.
choices: The clerk has wrote the receipt.
The clerk has written the receipt.
The clerk have written the receipt.
The clerk has writing the receipt.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses an adjective after a linking verb?
Choose the correct sentence for a completed action with a present result.
choices: I have lost my key, so I cannot open the door.
I lost my key yesterday, so I cannot open the door now.
I have lose my key, so I cannot open the door.
I am losing my key, so I could not open the door.

questions.question: Select the sentence with a correctly placed adverb of frequency.
choices: She checks usually the figures twice.
She usually checks the figures twice.
Usually she checks twice the figures.
She checks the figures twice usually always.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the possessive form of the plural noun children?
choices: The childrens' books are on the shelf.
The children's books are on the shelf.
The childrens books' are on the shelf.
The childrens's books are on the shelf.
